w2.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints
w2.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports GPU partitioning with NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), which divides one GPU into hardware-isolated partitions so you can run a different model in each or take a right-sized fraction of a newer accelerator. This post shows how two optional API fields place one model per partition, and what we measured against a whole older GPU.

w3.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick
w3.summary: As we built Amazon Quick, its agents grew from answering questions to taking actions, and the same primitives kept getting rebuilt under different names. This post shares the taxonomy we converged on — triggers, agents, capabilities, and learned context — found by decomposing agentic work into four plain questions: When, What, Who, and How.

w4.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate
w4.summary: Learn how to build a serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate that gives AI agents secure, metadata-driven access to an enterprise data lake. Exposing a new dataset requires only a JSON file, with no per-dataset integration code.

w5.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
w5.summary: In Part 1 you built one governed agent. Part 2 scales the pattern to an enterprise: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway becomes the single front door and redeems Okta's grant, Cedar policies bind each tool to the agent, a second agent runs on Amazon EKS, and AgentCore Observability traces every allow and deny beside Okta's log in Amazon CloudWatch.

w6.title: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
w6.summary: Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a tiered multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post covers the architecture, episodic memory for continuous learning, and the expansion from SOC operations into financial risk triage.

w7.title: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls
